title: Where is the target relative to me?
description: Request the target in base_link. Positive x means ahead; positive y means left. The same world target has different coordinates when the robot turns.
steps: Inspect the actual TF tree panel: world → odom → base_link, plus sensor and target frames. Before running, predict whether target y in base_link should be positive or negative.
Look up target with base_link as the target_frame argument.
Report translation.x and .y with report_relative, then compare with the visible target marker.
hints: lookup_transform(target_frame, source_frame, Time()) maps source coordinates into the target frame.
Requesting odom instead would give world-aligned coordinates, not robot-relative coordinates.
lookup_transform("base_link", "target", Time())

nl.title: Waar is het doel ten opzichte van mij?
nl.description: Vraag het doel in base_link. Positieve x is vooruit; positieve y is links van de robot.
steps: Bekijk de echte TF-boom en het target-frame. Voorspel vooraf of de y van het doel in base_link positief of negatief is.
Gebruik base_link als target_frame in lookup_transform.
Rapporteer translation.x en .y met report_relative.
hints: lookup_transform zet source-coördinaten om naar target_frame.
odom geeft wereldgerichte coördinaten, niet robotrelatieve.
Gebruik lookup_transform("base_link", "target", Time()).

fr.title: Où est la cible par rapport à moi ?
fr.description: Demandez la cible dans base_link. x positif signifie devant ; y positif signifie à gauche du robot.
steps: Observez l’arbre TF réel et le repère target. Avant de lancer, prédisez si y de la cible dans base_link est positif ou négatif.
Utilisez base_link comme target_frame dans lookup_transform.
Rapportez translation.x et .y avec report_relative.
hints: lookup_transform exprime les coordonnées source dans target_frame.
odom fournit des coordonnées alignées sur le monde, pas sur le robot.
Utilisez lookup_transform("base_link", "target", Time()).

es.title: Objetivo relativo al robot
es.description: Consulta target en base_link: x positivo es delante, y positivo es izquierda. Las coordenadas cambian al girar.
steps: Inspecciona el árbol TF con world, odom, base_link, sensores y target. Antes de ejecutar, predice si y del objetivo en base_link será positivo o negativo.
Consulta target usando base_link como target_frame.
Llama a report_relative con translation.x y translation.y y compara con el objetivo visible.
hints: lookup_transform(target_frame, source_frame, Time()) expresa source en target_frame.
Usar odom daría coordenadas alineadas con el mundo, no con el robot.
lookup_transform("base_link", "target", Time())

de.title: Das Ziel relativ zum Roboter
de.description: Frage target in base_link ab: positives x ist vorne, positives y links. Die Werte ändern sich beim Drehen.
steps: Untersuche den TF-Baum mit world, odom, base_link, Sensoren und target. Sage vor dem Start voraus, ob Ziel-y in base_link positiv oder negativ ist.
Frage target mit base_link als target_frame ab.
Melde translation.x und translation.y mit report_relative und vergleiche die Zielmarkierung.
hints: lookup_transform(target_frame, source_frame, Time()) drückt source in target_frame aus.
Mit odom wären die Koordinaten weltorientiert, nicht roboterrelativ.
lookup_transform("base_link", "target", Time())

pt.title: Alvo relativo ao robô
pt.description: Consulta target em base_link: x positivo é em frente, y positivo é à esquerda. As coordenadas mudam ao rodar.
steps: Inspeciona a árvore TF com world, odom, base_link, sensores e target. Antes de executar, prevê se y do alvo em base_link será positivo ou negativo.
Consulta target usando base_link como target_frame.
Chama report_relative com translation.x e translation.y e compara com o alvo visível.
hints: lookup_transform(target_frame, source_frame, Time()) expressa source em target_frame.
Usar odom daria coordenadas alinhadas com o mundo, não com o robô.
lookup_transform("base_link", "target", Time())

it.title: Dov’è il target rispetto al robot?
it.description: Richiedi il target in base_link. x positivo significa avanti; y positivo significa sinistra. Lo stesso target nel mondo cambia coordinate quando il robot ruota.
steps: Ispeziona l’albero TF: world → odom → base_link, più sensori e target. Prima di eseguire, prevedi se y del target in base_link sarà positivo o negativo.
Cerca target usando base_link come argomento target_frame.
Riporta translation.x e .y con report_relative e confrontali con il target visibile.
hints: lookup_transform(target_frame, source_frame, Time()) esprime le coordinate sorgenti nel riferimento di destinazione.
Richiedere odom darebbe coordinate allineate al mondo, non relative al robot.
lookup_transform("base_link", "target", Time())
